text:
anna_support: FYI customer escalation — analytics dashboard shows zero tokens/requests when Region=Europe + Model version is selected. They also saw some 503s earlier. Screenshot: https://screenshot.redwood/abc123 :eyes:

kevin_frontend: Can you paste repro steps? quick check: does selecting the explicit region (eu-central) change anything? :thinking:

anna_support: Steps I followed (customer): 1) Console -> Analytics -> Models. 2) Filters: Region = "Europe" (dropdown), Model = "gptx-3" and Version = "1.2". 3) Time range = last 1h. Result: charts empty, counts go to 0. If I remove Version it shows data.

dmitri_metrics: Hmm. Any API errors in the console network tab or backend logs?

anna_support: Customer mentioned earlier they saw a few API 503s to /v1/usage/metrics around the same time. I can share tenant id privately.

kevin_frontend: Pasting the client payload we send when you pick "Europe":
```
{"filters": {"region": ["eu"], "model": ["gptx-3:1.2"]}}
```

ops-bot: alert — sampling-rate-rewrite job completed at 1958766000 for org=redwood-customer, job_id=sr-42

jess_research: Idea: frontend normalizes the UI label "Europe" -> alias key "eu" and backend canonicalizes to "eu-central". If alias rewrite happens after the analytics query planner picks a sampling key, we may query an unmatched shard and get 0.

sara_prod: I saw a similar parity bug before — model+version selectors get rewritten to a namespaced token like "gptx-3:1.2" on the client, but the sampling index expects separate model and version fields. If rewrite order differs between layers you can fall through to an empty intersection.

dmitri_metrics: Can you reproduce with curl? If we can show the exact query payload and server response that helps triage.

anna_support: Here's a quick repro curl the customer ran (redacted tenant + timeframe):
```
curl -s -X GET 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/metrics?region=eu&model=gptx-3&version=1.2&from=1958762400&to=1958765400' -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
```
Response: 200 but metrics.empty = true, samples=0.

kevin_frontend: I grabbed a client log snippet from my local repro:
```
[client] sending filters -> {region:["eu"], model:["gptx-3:1.2"], ts:...}
[server] rewrite region alias -> eu-central
[server] query sampler -> shard_key="region:eu;model:gptx-3"
[server] sampler returned 0 samples
```

jess_research: That log shows the exact mismatch. Sampler used the original alias key and rewrite happened after.

sara_prod: Short-term workaround: customer should select "eu-central" explicitly in region dropdown or remove the Version selector. That should surface data.

dmitri_metrics: Action items: 1) Kevin — open a bug with reproduction steps + client/server logs. 2) Me + Jess — check sampler rewrite ordering and whether canonicalization is applied before sampler key generation. 3) Ops-bot — flag any correlated 5xxs for the tenant.

kevin_frontend: Created bug: GH#INF-4238 — included curl, client logs, server rewrite snippet, and screenshot. Assigning to eng-infra/sampling. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026 (priority P2) — linked to GH#INF-4238.

anna_support: I'll share the tenant id and the customer's recording in the bug and update them with the workaround. Thanks all. :pray:

kevin_frontend: will propose a small client fix: apply alias->canonical mapping earlier (client-side) as a mitigation while backend patch lands.

dmitri_metrics: Good. Once we have a backend fix we should add an integration test to prevent alias/sampler parity regressions.

anna_support: marking this thread as tracking. If anyone needs more logs ping me.
